extracted.intended_audience: sketch teams, comedians, festival attendees, and prospective students
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and descriptive criteria for a headliner sketch-comedy competition (Bragging Rights) presented as part of NYC SketchFest’25, including format, judging, and ticketing requirements. Also describes festival programming aims and available training classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team composition (random draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two teams of actors and comedians that are drafted together at random compete head to head against each other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams are formed by random draft—performers are grouped into competing teams by the show's drafting process rather than pre-existing teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition format — head-to-head sketch matchup
rubrics_metrics.description: BRAGGING RIGHTS is THE ULTIMATE sketch comedy competition where two teams ... compete head to head against each other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Live, direct competition between two opposing teams; format emphasizes comparative performance in the same show for immediate winner determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging and winner determination
rubrics_metrics.description: The audience and guest judges decide which team has the funnier material!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winner is determined subjectively by a mix of audience reaction and guest judges' decisions — emphasis on which team’s material is funnier to those groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticketing / admission requirement for headliner shows
rubrics_metrics.description: SINGLE-DAY PASSES, FOUR-DAY PASSES, PERFORMER PASSES WILL NOT BE ADMITTED TO HEADLINER SHOWS; HEADLINER TICKETS MUST BE PURCHASED FOR ADMISSION
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strict admission policy: only specific headliner tickets admit entry to headliner shows — festival pass types and performer passes are excluded from headliner entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival programming aims — diversity and range of teams
rubrics_metrics.description: NYC SKETCHFEST’25 aims to showcase both local and national sketch teams, spanning from established favorites to emerging groups, fostering a collective reunion of sketch brilliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programming selection emphasizes geographic diversity (local and national), career-stage diversity (established and emerging), and a variety of formats (e.g., digital sketch hours, 24 hour sketch show).

rubrics_metrics.name: Programming elements / show types included
rubrics_metrics.description: Programming will include DIGITAL SKETCH HOURS, the 24 HOUR SKETCH SHOW and more!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Festival programming includes a range of event formats, indicating opportunities for different sketch styles and timeframes (digital, marathon-format shows, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Training / class availability for performers
rubrics_metrics.description: Available Classes: Check out our affordable comedy classes, ranging from improv, sketch, stand up, & more! Offered In Person or Online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Theater provides training resources in multiple comedy disciplines and delivery modes (in-person and online) for performers seeking to prepare or improve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show credibility / history
rubrics_metrics.description: Bragging Rights is the longest running sketch comedy competition show in New York City history!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical longevity is used as a credibility signal for performers and audiences; suggests an established format and audience expectations.
